summary: Read the complete 524-line markdown conversion, including references and author biographies; the document contains no appendix. Checked the cited PDF pages, recovered Tables 1-4 with PyMuPDF, and inspected Figures 1-3 in memory. All 46 populated numeric or p-value fields in the four estimates match the PDF and belong to the recorded outcomes and arms. The participant counts, gain versus endpoint statistics, contrast directions, question, construct, unit, AI availability, timing, within_person, comparison_type, and se_basis are supported. Four problems flag one shared reporting gap: human scoring is confirmed, but the lay-rater subtype required by human_raters is not. No missing eligible outcome or full-sample randomized contrast was found. Randomization is stated only for switching within the initial A and B groups; the initial-group comparisons, within-arm time changes, and switching-asymmetry moderation contrast are appropriately excluded. The paper reports no arm-specific fluency or rubric-component effects.
